modes.label: Local or LAN deployment
modes.description: Runs backend, frontend, Ollama, and local data on the current machine.

modes.label: Direct public Linux server deployment
modes.description: Runs the full service on a public Linux server. Recommended only when the server has enough CPU/RAM/GPU for local models.

modes.label: Public frp tunnel deployment
modes.description: Runs models and backend on the local workstation while a public server provides Nginx HTTPS and frps.
